held_out_test.limitation: held-out operating load/records on the same public rig, not independently unseen bearing specimens or field validation

ml.test_access_note: Downloader parsed all files for integrity/provenance before training; test waveform statistics were not used for model/feature/scale selection

neighbor_train_validation_only_ablation.gate: float validation macro-F1 improvement >=2 percentage points AND PTQ validation accuracy loss <=2 percentage points

training_history.selection: validation macro F1, ties broken by lower training loss

neighbor_train_validation_only_ablation.scope: Predefined train/validation ablation; no new held-out test accuracy, FPGA fit or physical measurement claim
neighbor_train_validation_only_ablation.frequency_selection_method: predefined train_fisher_separated algorithm recomputed from train waveforms only
neighbor_train_validation_only_ablation.method_audit_note: The original v1 selected the frequency strategy using validation; its history is unchanged. These same centers were independently recomputed by the predefined train-only Fisher algorithm; no model refit or test evaluation was performed for this provenance clarification.

dequantized_logit_absolute_error.units: floating network logit units; integer logit multiplied by frozen logit_scale

quantization_difference.interpretation: Differences include input feature rounding, weight/bias quantization, hidden RNE and saturation; not weight quantization alone.

evaluation.scope: Subsequent frozen-model evaluation on CWRU 12 kHz drive-end, 3 HP records. These same records were previously evaluated for the original single-bin model; they are not a fresh external or previously untouched test set. The split is cross-load on the same laboratory rig, with three seeded fault classes and no normal class. This run provides no physical-hardware or field accuracy evidence.
evaluation.float_reference: Saved FP32 MLP with unrounded scaled/clamped INTEGER DSP powers (same reference as validation); not a fully floating-point DSP pipeline.
evaluation.window_protocol: Records split before nonoverlapping N=1024 windows; stride 1024; discard each record tail; frozen train-derived PCM scale; no window filtering.
evaluation.historical_status_note: The existing model JSON and neighbor validation report retain their historical test_evaluated=false fields. This separate subsequent result is joined by model_sha256.

not_yet_evidenced: physical board programming and Flash readback
actual ADXL345 captures, calibration or noise measurements
interpretation: Passing XML requires at least one non-skipped test and no failure/error. Missing evidence is never treated as success. Historical reports can outlive source edits; use source-lock and newer_source_paths appropriately.
